dataset_name: HER AI - HER_DAY Website Memory Dataset
intended_use: Personal-memory RAG ingestion and retrieval; not a model fine-tuning corpus by default.

architecture_target.retrieval: Hybrid metadata filtering + vector similarity + recency/temporal filters

processing.text_extraction: Extracted from the live website and its linked public GitHub HTML/text source files.

important_rules: Preserve source text and source IDs.
Attribute first-person claims to Vivek; do not present them as independently verified facts.
Do not infer HER's feelings, consent, intentions, or private traits.
Treat 'just friends' as a boundary that must be respected.
Treat AI-generated images as synthetic, not documentary evidence.
Do not generate voice clones or store voice biometrics without explicit permission.
Resolve review_flags before promoting uncertain events to high-confidence canonical memories.
Generate embeddings in the HER AI backend using its configured embedding model; this export contains no vectors.

review_flags.issue: Timeline title says 'The First Time Our Eyes Meet' but description says it was a road trip where mountains and ocean were seen in the same week.
review_flags.action: Ask Vivek what actually happened on 26 October 2024 and correct title or description.

review_flags.issue: Timeline title says 'The First Time Our Eyes Meet' but description says heartfelt words were spoken.
review_flags.action: Ask Vivek whether this was first eye contact, a letter/confession, or a different event.

review_flags.issue: Website says November 29 and letter date 29/11/2025; the countdown hardcodes 2025. The homepage timeline says 'Today'.
review_flags.action: Confirm the actual birthday date/year and distinguish birthday date from the year the site was published.

review_flags.issue: A birthday wish card is dated 14/04/2017, which is also the first-sighting date. The card's date may be a memory date rather than the letter's creation date.
review_flags.action: Confirm whether 14 April 2017 is the event date, letter date, or both.

review_flags.issue: Narrative says 'after two whole years' while the first sighting is dated 14 April 2017 and social-media ID discovery is dated 8 August 2023, a little over six years later.
review_flags.action: Clarify what the two-year period refers to; preserve both source statements until resolved.

review_flags.issue: The site records a 'just friends' boundary and lack of confirmed reciprocation.
review_flags.action: Keep this as a boundary/context memory. Never use romantic language as evidence that she reciprocates or wants a relationship.

review_flags.issue: The Love Museum page says some together-photos are AI-generated.
review_flags.action: Mark synthetic images clearly; do not use them as proof of actual co-presence or real events.
